sources.quote: Otherwise, if the design artifact's `contextFiles.<id>` file is absent or empty: mark **Design Adherence** as not verified.
If implementation changes cannot be identified, mark **Code Pattern Consistency** as not verified and explain the missing evidence.
Write the report to a file in the change directory: `/openspec/changes/issue/verify.md`.

unitemized.reason: Only applies 'if found' (whether implementation evidence was found is a judgment), and the doc gives no path:line format beyond the placeholder, so no checkable pattern or predicate fits.
Depends on whether divergence was detected, which is a judgment the reference language can't observe. The message text is only required under that condition.
Recommendation text is tied to a divergence finding, which can't be observed; there is no predicate to gate it.
Depends on the agent's judgment that a scenario 'appears uncovered'; that per-scenario coverage can't be expressed as a predicate.
Recommendation is tied to an uncovered-scenario finding, which can't be observed.
Skipping scenarios under REMOVED requirements is part of the reasoning process. No kind can check that REMOVED scenarios were left out of coverage analysis.
The sandbox schema defines a design artifact, so the 'no design artifact' condition never holds in this setup.
Depends on a design contradiction being detected, which is a judgment and can't be observed.
Recommendation is tied to a design-contradiction finding, which can't be observed.
Depends on 'significant deviations found', a subjective judgment that can't be observed.
Recommendation is tied to a pattern-deviation finding, which can't be observed.
The Summary section skeleton is already compiled from the verify template; this statement adds no rule of its own.

Which checks were skipped versus run (including check-script and code-reading evidence) and whether the change is removal/rename-only can't be expressed as an applies_when predicate. 'Never score a skipped check as passing' needs semantic judgment of each Status cell.
